header.heroTitle: Unify clinical workflows, automate documentation, and deliver AI-powered insights
header.heroSubtitle: Designed to reduce clinician workload and improve patient outcomes.

about.title: About Us
about.paragraph1: Quantum Vita was created to address a key problem in modern healthcare: systems that slow clinicians instead of supporting them. Doctors spend too much time on fragmented software, repetitive documentation, and administrative work.
about.paragraph2: Quantum Vita reduces this friction with a platform built around real clinical workflows. It unifies AI-powered documentation, medical records, laboratory data, and clinical intelligence in one secure system. Developed by experts in medicine and artificial intelligence, it supports decisions without disrupting judgment.

aim.title: Our Aim
aim.paragraph1: At Quantum Vita, our aim is to revolutionize healthcare through advanced AI and smart automation. We empower clinics to deliver faster, safer, and more accurate patient care. Every feature is built to simplify complex clinical workflows.
aim.paragraph2: Intelligent EMR systems and real-time lab integrations improve efficiency and accuracy. Our mission is to make every clinical decision smarter and more informed. Driven by innovation and reliability, Quantum Vita is shaping the future of modern healthcare.

feature1.title: AI-Assisted Speech to Text
feature1.text: Dictate patient notes naturally; let AI handle the documentation.
feature1.description: Physicians can speak freely during consultations while Quantum Vita's AI converts speech into structured, editable medical notes in real-time. It recognizes medical terminology, abbreviations, and context, automatically organizing notes by history, examination, assessment, and plan.
feature1.clinicalImpact: Saves hours per week, reduces errors, enhances note completeness, and ensures records are ready for audits or research.

feature2.title: AI Diagnostics & Support Chat-Bot
feature2.text: Your AI assistant that reviews, advises, and learns.
feature2.description: The chatbot analyzes patient history, labs, imaging, and prior interventions to suggest diagnoses, differential considerations, and guideline-based recommendations. It answers clinical queries, flags abnormal results, and evolves with each doctor interaction.
feature2.clinicalImpact: Improves decision-making, reduces cognitive load, enhances patient safety, and provides a second expert review at the point of care.

feature3.title: Labs & Imaging Integration
feature3.text: Centralize and visualize all diagnostic data seamlessly.
feature3.description: Labs and imaging are integrated directly into patient records via uploads, digital imports, or QR scans. Abnormal results are flagged, trends tracked, and visual graphs generated. Data is structured for easy retrieval, research, or audits.
feature3.clinicalImpact: Faster diagnosis, better monitoring, data-driven treatment planning, and reduced report loss.

feature4.title: One-Click Data Collection
feature4.text: Turn every patient visit into research-ready data.
feature4.description: All encounter details—including demographics, vitals, labs, imaging, and medications—are captured instantly in structured formats. Supports inclusion/exclusion criteria and auto-generates datasets for analytics or studies.
feature4.clinicalImpact: Enables clinics to function as research centers, simplifies study participation, and facilitates evidence-based improvements

feature5.title: Latest Articles Updates
feature5.text: Stay current without leaving your EMR.
feature5.description: Quantum Vita delivers filtered medical literature, journal updates, and guideline changes directly into the platform. Summaries highlight key insights for fast review, with links to full articles.
feature5.clinicalImpact: Ensures evidence-based decisions, continuous learning, and keeps clinicians aligned with evolving best practices.

feature6.title: Administrative Automation
feature6.text: Streamline clinic workflows and reduce paperwork.
feature6.description: Automates scheduling, reminders, insurance forms, and electronic consents. Staff workflows are prioritized with notifications, reducing errors and delays.
feature6.clinicalImpact: Saves staff and doctor time, improves patient flow, and allows clinicians to focus on care rather than administration.

feature7.title: Auditing
feature7.text: Track every action for compliance and quality assurance.
feature7.description: Logs all clinical and administrative actions with timestamps and user IDs. Dashboards highlight patterns, deviations, and workflow bottlenecks. Supports regulatory audits, quality control, and risk management.
feature7.clinicalImpact: Ensures compliance, enhances quality, protects against medico-legal risk, and validates clinical research.

feature8.title: Clinical Impact
feature8.text: Measure outcomes and optimize patient care.
feature8.description: Tracks patient responses to interventions, lab trends, vital changes, and complications. Correlation analytics identify which treatments work best for specific patient groups, informing data-driven care improvements.
feature8.clinicalImpact: Enables evidence-based practice optimization, personalized treatment planning, and resource allocation.

feature9.title: Cloud-Based Encryption
feature9.text: Secure, compliant access to patient data anytime, anywhere.
feature9.description: Patient records are stored on encrypted cloud servers with HIPAA/GDPR compliance. Role-based access, multi-level authentication, and audit logs ensure security while allowing collaboration across devices.
feature9.clinicalImpact: Safeguards patient privacy, enables real-time access, and supports secure multi-device workflows.
